13.007.p: Thought Adjusters are pure spirit—possibly absolute spirit in nature—and certainly more than mere spirit entities [107:6.1], 107:6.4. They convey the Father’s nature flawlessly to the human soul and serve in every universe age with complete faithfulness and perfection [110:3.3].
13.008.h3: 2. Mission and Purpose of Thought Adjusters
13.009.h4: 1) Representatives of the Father and Eternal Promise
13.010.p: The supreme mission of a Thought Adjuster is to represent the Universal Father within the mortal mind and to be the Father’s presence in that individual [108:0.1]. Adjusters are the eternal guarantee of the survival of the immortal soul and the promise of ascension toward divine perfection and Paradise attainment [107:0.2].
13.011.h4: 2) Fusion and Eternal Union with the Soul
13.012.p: Fusion between an Adjuster and a human soul is the actual experience of eternal union with God [107:0.4]. This fusion creates a new order of being—the immortal finaliter—combining the Adjuster’s divine nature with the experiential identity of the soul [108:0.1].
13.014.p: Thought Adjusters act as the infallible spiritual compass, always leading the soul Godward with flawless precision [107:0.6]. Their purpose is not to ease human life, but to stimulate moral decision, strengthen character, and prepare the soul for the eternal adventure beyond this world [108:5.5]–5.6.
13.015.h3: 3. Classification and Home of Thought Adjusters
13.017.p: Adjusters are classified into seven categories—Virgin, Advanced, Supreme, Fused, and Personalized Adjusters among them—and each type has a destiny of liberation, fusion, or personalization [107:2.2]–2.8. Personalized Adjusters include those who served with incarnated Paradise Sons, including Jesus of Nazareth [107:2.8], 109:6.4.
13.019.p: An Adjuster may become volitionally active when the human reaches a high level of spiritual balance (such as the third psychic circle) or when full and sincere cooperation with the Adjuster is achieved [109:2.2]–2.4. These Adjusters demonstrate independent will in matters unrelated to human personality and may temporarily leave the body when necessary [109:2.8], 109:2.10.
13.021.p: All Adjuster activities are coordinated from Divinington, one of the seven sacred spheres of the Father surrounding Paradise [107:3.1]. Adjusters return there after the death of their human subjects and receive training, coordination, and assignment for further ministry [108:3.7].
13.024.p: Thought Adjusters indwell the human mind, not the physical brain [110:1.1], and are assigned only when a child becomes capable of moral decision-making. On Urantia, they typically arrive around age 5 years, 10 months, and 4 days [108:2.1]. Acceptance requires a mind capable of worship and choosing between moral values [108:2.2].
13.025.h4: 2) Direct Connection and Respect for Free Will
13.026.p: Once the Adjuster indwells, no intermediary exists between God and the human personality [108:2.4]. Yet Adjusters never override free will; all their plans remain subject to human choice and consent [110:2.1]. Survival itself must be freely chosen by the mortal creature [110:2.2].
13.028.p: Human personality growth unfolds through the mastery of the seven psychic circles [110:6.1]. The Adjuster is the mortal’s equal partner in ascending from the seventh to the first circle [110:6.2]. Reaching the first circle represents the highest possible Adjuster-mind relationship during mortal life, enabling limited direct communication [110:6.15].
13.031.p: Adjusters never fail, and they never lose anything of survival value [109:6.1]. If a human fails to survive, the Adjuster preserves every worthy experience and transfers these spiritual values for use in another ascension candidate’s mind [109:6.1]–6.2.
13.033.p: After fusion, the Adjuster and the soul become one unified being [110:7.8]. The fused being carries both the total experiential memory of human life and the spiritual memory of the Adjuster’s ministry [110:7.5].
13.034.h4: 3) Eternal Companion on the Paradise Journey
13.035.p: The Adjuster is the eternal guide leading the ascendant being toward the Universal Father and ultimate divinity attainment. Yet the final decision for eternal survival always rests with the sacred sovereignty of human free will.
